answer: Escrowed origination bridge: each agent identity must post a refundable deposit plus a one-time work proof, and any new agent can only join by routing through an existing verified agent who co-signs. The co-signer's own deposit is slashed if the newcomer sybils, so clones force sponsors to risk capital, and a single dune of fake identities drains the sponsor's balance fast. Sponsors get a nectar reward only when the newcomer completes real transactions, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
